At a glance

What is Messify?

Quick answer

Messify is a Dubai meal-plan and catering company. Its meals are cooked fresh every day in a partner kitchen in International City and delivers breakfast, lunch and dinner together each morning across Dubai Academic City, Dubai Silicon Oasis and International City, from AED 25.63 a meal. It also caters corporate events, parties, university events and weddings across Dubai, Sharjah, Ajman and Abu Dhabi.

Meal plan pricesAED 215–610 a week or AED 715–1,999 a month (AED 25.63–30.71 per meal)
DeliveryEvery morning, all the day's meals in one chilled bag
FoodBalanced and 100% halal, with a new menu every day
Flexibility1 meal = 1 token. Skip a day and use the token later in your plan.
Meal plan areasDubai Academic City, Dubai Silicon Oasis, International City
Catering areasDubai, Sharjah, Ajman and Abu Dhabi

Questions

Good to know.

How much does a meal plan cost in Dubai with Messify?

Weekly plans cost AED 215, 415 or 610 for 1, 2 or 3 meals a day. Monthly plans cost AED 715, 1,400 or 1,999. That works out to AED 25.63 to 30.71 per meal.

Which areas do you deliver meal plans to?

We deliver meal plans every morning across Dubai Academic City, Dubai Silicon Oasis, International City and nearby areas. Message us on WhatsApp to check your building.

Do you cater parties and events?

Yes. We cater corporate events, office lunches, parties and home events, university events, weddings and bulk orders across Dubai, Sharjah, Ajman and Abu Dhabi. Every menu is custom and priced by headcount.

How do I start a meal plan?

Download the Messify app, pick your plan and pay in the app. Prefer to talk first? Message us on WhatsApp at +971 50 251 3033.
